$comment: ADR-372 stairs and second-floor access. All tunables for stair traversal live here, not in code. (ADR-594: the brokenChance / brokenExteriorChance knobs are gone — abandoned sites always spawn with their stairs.) pathStairCost: A* cost of one level change on a stair tile (findPath + creature nav). maxPathLevel: highest level the level-aware pathfinders route to (townhouses have 3 stories = levels 0..2). upDir: the tile direction the top of a rot-0 stairs piece faces (rot rotates it with the site, same basis as rotPoint); verify against the stair sprite on the live build — if the art ascends the other way, flip this, not the code. exteriorKinds: abandoned kind keys that also get an outside stair run (south side) up to a level-1 balcony + doorway; kinds with a south pen yard (homestead, manor) keep interior stairs only.
